title: Transpose a matrix and measure its memory accesses
audience: Students with basic programming knowledge who are learning assembly
prerequisites: Nested loops and retained delayed branches
learningObjectives: Derive separate rectangular source and destination strides
Implement empty and clipped tile bounds
Preserve full pointer width while using bounded indices
Distinguish data correctness from traversal order
Compare cold cache placement and simulated instruction counts without inferring elapsed time

inputDomain.activeWindows: nonoverlapping, word aligned, wholly inside named allocations

progression.localImplementation: Text guides, author-verified cumulative programs, and complete-program CLI checks
